ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡學習不規則動詞。

ex.en: He works irregular hours.
ex.zh: 他的工作時間不固定。

irregular.en: not following the usual pattern or happening at even times

ex.en: The auditors found some irregular payments.
ex.zh: 稽核人員發現了一些不合規定的付款。

ex.en: This procedure is highly irregular.
ex.zh: 這個程序非常不合規定。

ex.en: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
ex.zh: 如果有人惹你生氣，最好不要馬上反應。

ex.en: Tom said that he was irritated.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他很煩。

ex.en: He became irritated.
ex.zh: 他開始不耐煩了。

ex.en: This soap may irritate your skin.
ex.zh: 這塊肥皂可能會刺激皮膚。

ex.en: Smoke irritates my eyes.
ex.zh: 煙會刺激我的眼睛。

irritate.en: to make part of the body red, sore or painful

ex.en: Sometimes I find that I basically have no time to pay attention to irrelevant trivia.
ex.zh: 有時候我發現自己根本沒時間理會無關緊要的瑣事。

ex.en: His age is irrelevant to the job.
ex.zh: 他的年齡和這份工作無關。

ex.en: Please remove any irrelevant information from the report.
ex.zh: 請刪除報告中不相關的資訊。

irrelevant.en: not connected to the subject being discussed

ex.en: She finished ironing the clothes a few minutes ago.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘前燙完了衣服。

ex.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
ex.zh: 先燙領子內側，再燙外側。

iron.en: to make clothes smooth with a hot flat tool

ex.en: I cannot iron my clothes. I have no iron.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法燙衣服，我沒有熨斗。

ex.en: Be careful, the iron is still hot.
ex.zh: 小心，熨斗還很燙。

iron.en: a hot flat tool used to make clothes smooth

ex.en: The gate is made of iron.
ex.zh: 這扇大門是鐵做的。

ex.en: Spinach is rich in iron.
ex.zh: 菠菜富含鐵質。

iron.en: a hard grey metal used to make tools and buildings

ex.en: The farmers built an irrigation system.
ex.zh: 農民建造了灌溉系統。

ex.en: Irrigation is essential in dry areas.
ex.zh: 在乾燥地區，灌溉不可或缺。

irrigation.en: the supply of water to land so that crops can grow

ex.en: Tom said that he was irritated.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他很煩躁。

ex.en: He became irritated.
ex.zh: 他開始生氣了。

ex.en: My eyes are red and irritated from the smoke.
ex.zh: 我的眼睛被煙燻得又紅又痛。

ex.en: The irritated skin needs a few days to heal.
ex.zh: 發炎的皮膚需要幾天才會痊癒。

ironic.zh: 具有諷刺意味的、諷刺的

ex.en: That's ironic, isn't it?
ex.zh: 真諷刺，不是嗎？

ex.en: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
ex.zh: 消防局竟然被燒毀，真是諷刺。

ironic.en: strange or funny because it is the opposite of what you expect

ex.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.
ex.zh: 他早上總是有點脾氣暴躁。

ex.en: Irritable men are always the last to know about things.
ex.zh: 脾氣不好的人總是最晚獲知任何訊息。

ex.en: The baby gets irritable when he is tired.
ex.zh: 寶寶累了就會鬧脾氣。

ex.en: The irony is that the fire station itself burned down.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局本身竟然被燒毀了。

ex.en: She said "great job" with obvious irony in her voice.
ex.zh: 她說「做得好」時，語氣裡帶著明顯的諷刺。

irony.en: a funny or strange situation that is the opposite of what you expect

ironically.zh: 諷刺地、具有諷刺意味地

ex.en: Ironically, the fire station was damaged by a fire.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局竟然遭受火災。

ex.en: Ironically, he missed the meeting about being on time.
ex.zh: 諷刺的是，他錯過了那場討論準時的會議。

ex.en: "Great job," she said ironically after I spilled the soup.
ex.zh: 我把湯灑出來後，她挖苦地說：「幹得好。」

ex.en: He smiled ironically and clapped his hands slowly.
ex.zh: 他嘲諷地笑著，慢慢地拍著手。

ex.en: Ireland is an island country west of Britain.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭是位於英國西邊的島國。

ex.en: Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
ex.zh: 都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。

ex.en: The grass in Ireland stays green for most of the year.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭的草地一年中大部分時間都是綠的。

ex.en: The Irish are known for their music and friendly pubs.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭人以音樂和友善的酒館聞名。

ex.en: Some schools in Ireland teach in Irish instead of English.
ex.zh: 愛爾蘭有些學校以愛爾蘭語而非英語授課。

ex.en: We listened to Irish music at the small café.
ex.zh: 我們在小咖啡館聽了愛爾蘭音樂。

ex.en: Her grandmother has an Irish accent.
ex.zh: 她的祖母有愛爾蘭口音。

ex.en: She met an Iraqi doctor at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上認識了一位伊拉克醫生。

ex.en: Many Iraqis enjoy drinking sweet tea with friends.
ex.zh: 許多伊拉克人喜歡和朋友一起喝甜茶。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of ancient Iraqi art.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了許多古代伊拉克藝術品。

ex.en: He cooked a traditional Iraqi dish for the guests.
ex.zh: 他為客人煮了一道傳統的伊拉克菜。

ex.en: Iraq is a country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 伊拉克是中東的一個國家。

ex.en: The rivers Tigris and Euphrates both flow through Iraq.
ex.zh: 底格里斯河與幼發拉底河都流經伊拉克。

ex.en: Tehran is the capital of Iran.
ex.zh: 德黑蘭是伊朗的首都。

ex.en: Iran is a large country in the Middle East.
ex.zh: 伊朗是中東的一個大國。

ex.en: We tried an Iranian dish made with rice and herbs.
ex.zh: 我們嚐了一道用米飯和香草做成的伊朗菜。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of Iranian carpets.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有大量的伊朗地毯收藏。

ex.en: An Iranian student gave a talk about her hometown.
ex.zh: 一位伊朗學生分享了她家鄉的故事。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Iranian who teaches at the university.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是一位在大學任教的伊朗人。

ex.en: She could not hide her irritation when the meeting ran late.
ex.zh: 會議拖延時，她掩飾不住自己的不耐煩。

ex.en: He sighed in irritation at the constant noise.
ex.zh: 他對持續不斷的噪音惱怒地嘆了口氣。

ex.en: The new soap caused some skin irritation.
ex.zh: 這種新肥皂造成皮膚有些刺激不適。

ex.en: Dust can cause eye irritation and make them red.
ex.zh: 灰塵會刺激眼睛，使眼睛發紅。

ex.en: The iris is the colored part of the eye.
ex.zh: 虹膜是眼睛有顏色的部分。

ex.en: Her iris is a deep shade of brown.
ex.zh: 她的虹膜是深棕色的。

ex.en: Purple irises were blooming along the garden path.
ex.zh: 紫色的鳶尾花沿著花園小徑盛開。

ex.en: She painted a picture of a single iris.
ex.zh: 她畫了一幅單獨一朵鳶尾花的畫。

ex.en: It was irresponsible of him to leave the children alone.
ex.zh: 他把孩子獨自留下，真是不負責任。

ex.en: Driving after drinking is irresponsible and dangerous.
ex.zh: 酒後駕車既不負責任又危險。

ex.en: His fear of small dogs is completely irrational.
ex.zh: 他對小狗的恐懼完全不合理。

ex.en: It is irrational to spend money you don't have.
ex.zh: 花你沒有的錢是不理智的。

irresistible.zh: 無法抗拒的；極具吸引力的

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible.
ex.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味讓人無法抗拒。

ex.en: He found her smile irresistible.
ex.zh: 他覺得她的笑容讓人無法抗拒。

ex.en: The store is offering an irresistible discount this weekend.
ex.zh: 這間店本週末推出令人難以抗拒的折扣。

ex.en: The constant noise from the street is really irritating.
ex.zh: 街上不斷的噪音真的很煩人。

ex.en: He has an irritating habit of tapping his pen.
ex.zh: 他有個很討人厭的習慣，老愛敲筆。

ex.en: This soap can be irritating to sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 這種肥皂可能會刺激敏感肌膚。

ex.en: The smoke was irritating to my eyes.
ex.zh: 煙霧刺激得我的眼睛不舒服。

ex.en: The doctor noticed an irregularity in his heartbeat.
ex.zh: 醫生發現他的心跳有不規則的現象。

ex.en: An irregularity in the accounts led to an investigation.
ex.zh: 帳目上的異常引發了調查。

ex.en: The Irishman at the next table spoke with a soft accent.
ex.zh: 隔壁桌的愛爾蘭男子說話帶著柔和的口音。

ex.en: An Irishman, an Englishman and a Scotsman walked into a bar, says the old joke.
ex.zh: 老笑話說，有個愛爾蘭人、一個英格蘭人和一個蘇格蘭人走進酒吧。

ex.en: The damage to the old building was irreversible.
ex.zh: 那棟老建築受到的損害無法挽回。

ex.en: Once you delete the file, the action is irreversible.
ex.zh: 一旦刪除檔案，這個動作就無法復原。

ex.en: "Stop tapping your pen," he said irritably.
ex.zh: 「別再敲你的筆了，」他不耐煩地說。

ex.en: She answered irritably because she had slept very little.
ex.zh: 她因為沒睡多少，回答時語氣很煩躁。

ex.en: Everyone is welcome, irrespective of age.
ex.zh: 不論年齡，人人都歡迎。

ex.en: The rules apply to all, irrespective of position.
ex.zh: 這些規定對所有人適用，不論職位高低。

ex.en: I do the ironing on Sunday evenings.
ex.zh: 我通常在週日晚上燙衣服。

ex.en: There is a pile of ironing waiting on the bed.
ex.zh: 床上有一堆等著燙的衣服。

ex.en: Irving is a given name for boys.
ex.zh: 歐文是一個男孩的名字。

ex.en: Washington Irving was an American author who wrote Rip Van Winkle.
ex.zh: 華盛頓·歐文是美國作家，寫了《李伯大夢》。

ex.en: His rude comment raised the ire of the whole class.
ex.zh: 他無禮的話激起了全班的憤怒。

ex.en: The mayor's decision drew the ire of local shop owners.
ex.zh: 市長的決定引來當地店家的怒火。

ex.en: Farmers irrigate their fields during the dry season.
ex.zh: 農夫在乾季灌溉農田。

ex.en: The canal was built to irrigate the nearby land.
ex.zh: 這條運河是為了灌溉附近的土地而建的。

ex.en: The nurse irrigated the wound with clean water.
ex.zh: 護理師用乾淨的水沖洗傷口。

ex.en: Doctors irrigate the cut before closing it.
ex.zh: 醫生在縫合前會先沖洗傷口。

ex.en: His irreverent jokes made the teacher frown.
ex.zh: 他不敬的玩笑讓老師皺起眉頭。

ex.en: The comedy show takes an irreverent look at famous people.
ex.zh: 這個喜劇節目以不恭敬的角度看待名人。

ex.en: The soap bubble was iridescent in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 肥皂泡在陽光下閃著虹彩。

ex.en: She admired the iridescent wings of the beetle.
ex.zh: 她欣賞那隻甲蟲閃著虹彩的翅膀。

ex.en: The irate customer demanded to speak to the manager.
ex.zh: 那位憤怒的顧客要求見經理。

ex.en: My father was irate when he saw the broken window.
ex.zh: 我爸看到破掉的窗戶時非常生氣。

ex.en: Irradiation can be used to kill germs in some foods.
ex.zh: 輻射照射可用來殺死某些食物中的細菌。

ex.en: The patient received irradiation to treat the tumor.
ex.zh: 病人接受放射線照射來治療腫瘤。

ex.en: His constant tapping began to irk me.
ex.zh: 他不停地敲打，開始讓我惱火。

ex.en: It irks her when people arrive late.
ex.zh: 別人遲到會讓她很不高興。

ex.en: Their friendship was irrevocably damaged by the argument.
ex.zh: 那場爭吵讓他們的友誼無法挽回地受損。

ex.en: Once you press send, the decision is irrevocably made.
ex.zh: 一旦按下送出，這個決定就無法撤回。

ex.en: My grandmother's ring is irreplaceable to me.
ex.zh: 我祖母的戒指對我來說是無可取代的。

ex.en: She is an irreplaceable member of our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊中不可替代的一員。

ex.en: Smoke is a common irritant for the eyes.
ex.zh: 煙是眼睛常見的刺激物。

ex.en: Dust can be an irritant for people with allergies.
ex.zh: 灰塵可能會刺激有過敏的人。

ex.en: The irritant gas made everyone cough.
ex.zh: 那種刺激性氣體讓每個人都咳嗽。

ex.en: Avoid using irritant cleaning products without gloves.
ex.zh: 使用刺激性清潔用品時要戴手套。

ex.en: The lawyer pointed out the irrelevance of the question.
ex.zh: 律師指出那個問題與案件無關。

ex.en: Her comment sank into irrelevance as the talk moved on.
ex.zh: 隨著談話繼續，她的評論變得無關緊要。

ex.en: The bus runs irregularly on weekends.
ex.zh: 這路公車在週末的班次不固定。

ex.en: He sleeps irregularly, sometimes at noon and sometimes at night.
ex.zh: 他的睡眠很不規律，有時中午睡，有時晚上睡。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can cause irritability.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足可能導致易怒。

ex.en: His irritability made him hard to work with.
ex.zh: 他的暴躁讓人很難跟他共事。

irrevocable.zh: 不可撤銷的、無法挽回的

ex.en: Once you sign, the decision is irrevocable.
ex.zh: 一旦簽名，這個決定就不可撤銷。

ex.en: He made an irrevocable mistake.
ex.zh: 他犯了一個無法挽回的錯誤。

ex.en: The boy had irrepressible energy and never sat still.
ex.zh: 那個男孩精力旺盛到壓抑不住，從來坐不住。

ex.en: She burst into irrepressible laughter.
ex.zh: 她忍不住爆出一陣大笑。

irreconcilable.zh: 無法調和的；不能和解的

ex.en: The couple divorced because of irreconcilable differences.
ex.zh: 這對夫妻因為無法調和的歧見而離婚。

ex.en: The two sides hold irreconcilable views on the issue.
ex.zh: 雙方對這個議題的看法水火不容。

ex.en: The gate is decorated with beautiful ironwork.
ex.zh: 大門上裝飾著漂亮的鐵製工藝。

ex.en: The old balcony's ironwork had started to rust.
ex.zh: 舊陽台的鐵件已經開始生鏽。

irresistibly.zh: 不可抗拒地；極具誘惑地

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread drew us irresistibly into the bakery.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味令人無法抗拒地把我們吸進了麵包店。

ex.en: The baby is irresistibly cute when she laughs.
ex.zh: 寶寶笑起來可愛得讓人無法抗拒。

ex.en: Leaving the stove on was pure irresponsibility.
ex.zh: 把爐火開著不管，簡直是不負責任。

ex.en: His irresponsibility cost the team the whole project.
ex.zh: 他的不負責任讓整個團隊丟了這個專案。

ex.en: Filling out the same form again was an irksome task.
ex.zh: 又要再填一次同樣的表格，真是件煩人的事。

ex.en: His irksome habit of tapping his pen drove me crazy.
ex.zh: 他一直敲筆的討厭習慣快把我逼瘋了。

irreparable.zh: 無法彌補的；無法修復的

ex.en: The fire caused irreparable damage to the old library.
ex.zh: 那場火對舊圖書館造成了無法彌補的損害。

ex.en: Lying to her friend did irreparable harm to their trust.
ex.zh: 對朋友說謊對他們之間的信任造成了無法挽回的傷害。

ex.en: They signed an ironclad contract with the supplier.
ex.zh: 他們與供應商簽下了一份滴水不漏的合約。

ex.en: She had an ironclad alibi for that night.
ex.zh: 她對那晚有無懈可擊的不在場證明。

irrigated.zh: 灌溉（irrigate 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: Farmers irrigated the fields during the dry season.
ex.zh: 農民在乾季灌溉田地。

ex.en: The land was irrigated by water from the nearby river.
ex.zh: 這片土地以附近河流的水來灌溉。

ex.en: He gave me an ironical smile when I said I was fine.
ex.zh: 我說我沒事時，他給了我一個諷刺的微笑。

ex.en: It is ironical that the fire station burned down.
ex.zh: 消防局竟然被燒毀，真是諷刺。

ex.en: The irrationality of his fear surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他恐懼得毫無道理，讓大家很驚訝。

ex.en: Anger can lead to irrationality in decisions.
ex.zh: 憤怒可能讓人做出不理性的決定。

ex.en: The video was irrefutable proof that he was there.
ex.zh: 那段影片是他當時在場的無可辯駁的證據。

ex.en: She made an irrefutable argument, and no one replied.
ex.zh: 她提出無可辯駁的論點，沒人能回應。
